prompts.text: Create a SUMMA workflow for domain BowRiver3 with experiment exp001. Use pour point 51.3500000/-116.0200000, delineate the domain, and run from 2020-01-01 to 2020-12-31. Include setup, preprocessing, model run, and postprocessing.
